verdict.rationale: Algolia documents Rules that override relevance and reposition specific products in results for queries, including temporary changes (algolia-docs-56, algolia-docs-33). Merchandising Studio provides visual tools for curating, pinning and boosting results (algolia-docs-27), and the official CLI skill manages rules and synonyms (algolia-docs-50). missing for 10: explicit evidence of hiding/excluding specific hits, in-depth synonym documentation (synonyms appear only in the CLI skill description), independent or hands-on corroboration of query-specific curation.
